ruleset.name: nitpicker
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD rules for main and test sources.

rule.message: Field {0} has the same name as a method; a method named exactly like its field with at most one parameter (an accessor, a fluent setter or builder step) is allowed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static' and pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId [some $method in ../../..[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody]/MethodDeclaration satisfies lower-case(@Name) = lower-case($method/@Name) and not(@Name = $method/@Name and $method/FormalParameters[@Size < 2])]

rule.message: This literal in the condition is a magic number; -1, 0, 1 and 2 are allowed.
This operand assigns a variable; an assignment in a while condition is allowed.
This interface has one abstract method but no @FunctionalInterface annotation.
This log call computes its arguments even when its level is off.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]] [not(ArgumentList/*[position() > 1][not( self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression or self::StringLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::CharLiteral or self::NullLiteral or (self::MethodCall[ArgumentList[@Size = 0]] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression]]))])]

rule.name: LogStringConcatenation
rule.message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]] /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1]) [(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'] and not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())) or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted')]]

rule.name: GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode
rule.message: JaCoCo and PIT skip code annotated @Generated, so this is not measured. Remove the annotation from hand-written code.
Use a ReentrantLock, an atomic or a concurrent collection instead of a synchronized method.

rule.name: NonFinalStaticField
rule.message: Make this static field final, or keep the state in an instance. Mutable static state is shared by every caller and every test.
rule.description: A non-final static field is global mutable state.

rule.name: MutableStaticCollection
rule.message: Do not mutate a static collection or expose a mutable one. Build it once as an immutable List.of, Map.of or Map.copyOf, or keep the state in an instance.
rule.description: A static final collection that is public or changed after class loading is global mutable state.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final'] [VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private' and VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListSet')])] [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public' or ancestor::ClassBody[1]//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('add', 'addAll', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'remove', 'clear', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'offer', 'push', 'poll', 'pop', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'removeIf', 'replaceAll', 'sort')] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name = $name] [ancestor::MethodDeclaration or ancestor::ConstructorDeclaration]]
